source.notes: 5초 미션, a party game of one-word missions against a burning fuse (fictional game)
Korean OFL fonts, cut to the characters the reel shows

rationale.palette: A new primary for every mission (red #FF5A5F, blue #3DA5FF, yellow #FFC531, violet #7B61FF, green #2ECC71, orange, pink, teal) under moving white diagonal stripes; heavy black outlines #141018; a dark status bar #1B1B2F; yellow #FFE14D for the logo and the level.
rationale.type: Bagel Fat One, fat and bouncy, for the one-word instructions and the logo, outlined in black; Galmuri11, a Korean pixel font, for the status bar and the small print, always at a whole multiple of its 12-pixel grid.
rationale.motion: Every mission is one progress value from instruction to success: the word pops in with a spring, the action plays (catch, dodge, press, pop, feed, wipe, wake, score), a 성공! stamp slams in, the fuse burns down; the missions shrink from four beats to two to one with 속도 UP! cards between, and the stripes run faster.
rationale.sound: Chiptune at 144 BPM in D major (pulse arps, triangle bass, a pulse lead, kick, snare and hats); the tempo never changes: the sections get denser (sixteenth hats in the drops) as the missions get shorter; a blip for every instruction, a coin for every success, beeps for the count, pops for the boss balloons.
rationale.visuals: All code: eight missions drawn from simple shapes with thick outlines, each a function of its progress; striped backgrounds; a star-burst for success; the fuse is a line with a sparking star.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: the words are the commands.
